title: ICE Officer Involved in Maine Shooting Expressed Hatred of Immigrants
summary: The agent talked of foreign bloodlines, denounced noncitizens and more, according to emails obtained by The Times. His fatal shooting of a Colombian-born motorist in July remains under investigation.
